wire_rule: approved shapes. Version 13 only. The closed diagnostic identity table gains its second spelling: [254][u32 4]['Send'][declaration address], after the language rows (after NonNull's row when both exist), installed into the consumer's own LangItem::Send slot. No new tag or bit: the trait header's existing AUTO (4) and UNSAFE (1) flags are admitted for an exact empty auto declaration (no written parameters, supertraits, members, region captures or bounds, and a single unsized unqualified Self slot); a role-bound marker also carries its local role's exact flags (Freeze, Send, Sync and UnsafeUnpin unsafe auto, Unpin safe auto); CONST stays rejected with `source const/auto/unsafe traits require a wider explicit profile`.
